the deeper the cup, the thinner the prelaminar tissue.

The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a significant relationship between the thickness of prelaminar tissue, lamina cribrosae, and cup depth.
the association of cup depth with both prelaminar and laminar structures suggests the presence of a common mechanism in the pathogenesis of glaucoma.
there is an association between cup depth and LC thickness, suggesting that the LC is an important structure in the pathogenesis of glaucoma.
